items.work: Define audience/decision scope, collect actual evidence, code/review, write/design and finalise with rights/currentness checks.
items.owner_role_requirement: Research and editorial owner; actual capacity not confirmed.
items.completion_evidence: Versioned publishable evidence and complete contracted publication; do not count future sponsor-specific editions as already funded.

items.work: Choose supported sections/contrasts and relevant existing framework/templates for the stated use.
items.completion_evidence: A short task-based route through the edition, without new bespoke study or invented case evidence.

items.work: Set user/audience, agenda, preparation, format and follow-up boundary; identify a capable available person.
items.owner_role_requirement: Briefing/service owner; no staffed analyst bench or time promise presumed.
items.completion_evidence: Defined service and its complete labour cost; capacity and price assessed later.

items.work: Specify material/version, allowed use, source/participant constraints, funding statement and logo permissions where relevant.
items.owner_role_requirement: JGA publication/commercial owner and appropriate rights review.
items.completion_evidence: Actual agreed use/asset record; no default third-party rights or participant data access.

items.work: Screen relevant fit, choose practical input/meeting mode, apply existing permission and count policy.
items.owner_role_requirement: Research/participation/moderation owner; tools and arrangements not approved by this map.
items.completion_evidence: Actual eligible usable permitted contribution and separately tracked peer/event participation.

items.work: Prepare a short note with appropriate takeaways, limits and open questions; review for indirect identification.
items.owner_role_requirement: Editorial/moderation follow-through capacity to test and cost.
items.completion_evidence: A scoped optional benefit; no unlimited advice or recurring output.

items.work: Add recruitment, host/moderator seats, venue/hospitality, access, travel, timing and cancellation work.
items.owner_role_requirement: Event/programme owner and funding; no supplier enquiry or booking made.
items.completion_evidence: Incremental fully loaded resource/cash model against the research-only route, not all sales attributed to dinners.

items.work: Define proposal/contract/invoice/fulfilment/correction work, edition period and any genuinely chosen future refresh.
items.owner_role_requirement: Commercial/administrative/editorial owners, not an assumed recurring team.
items.completion_evidence: Count bundled licences once; distinguish contracted, invoiced, received and fulfilled; no automatic renewal.
